shoad.definition:
n. A train of vein material mixed with rubbish; fragments of
   ore which have become separated by the action of water or the weather,
   and serve to direct in the discovery of mines.

shoal.definition:
n. a sandbank in a stretch of water that is visible at low tide
n. a stretch of shallow water
shoal.translation:
n. 浅水, 浅滩, 沙洲, 鱼群, 暗礁, 潜在危险
a. 浅的
vi. 鱼成群而游, 变浅
vt. 使变浅

shoaled.translation: vi. 变浅（shoal的过去式与过去分词形式）

shoaler.translation: n. 沿海贸易商船, 沿海贸易水手

shoaliness.definition:
n. The quality or state of being shoaly; little depth of
   water; shallowness.

shoaling.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Shoal
a. Becoming shallow gradually.

shoals.definition:
n a sandbank in a stretch of water that is visible at low tide
n a stretch of shallow water
n a large group of fish
v make shallow
v become shallow
shoals.translation: n. 浅滩( shoal的名词复数 ); 沙洲; 鱼群; 大量

shoaly.definition: s full of submerged reefs or sandbanks or shoals

shoats.definition:
plural of shoat
n a young pig
